sourceRefs.locator: Heading, opening and dating clause: 1 March 752, Verberie, rex Francorum. Narrative: Loba’s testament, Gislemar’s admission and surrender per festucam, Fulrad, and the preceding hearing before King Chilperic.
Opening, “Replacing the ruling dynasty”: Pippin’s two documentary titles, the limits on dating the change, contemporary Roman evidence and the retrospective accounts produced under Carolingian rule.
Julian and proleptic Gregorian leap-year rules: in June 751 and March 752 the Gregorian date is four days later.

labels.de: Pippin urteilt als König in Verberie
labels.en: Pippin gives judgment as king at Verberie

note.de: Abt Fulrad machte Lobas Schenkung an Saint-Denis geltend. Am 1. März 752 erkannte ihr Sohn Gislemar sie vor Pippins Gericht an. Das Urteil nennt Pippin König der Franken.
note.en: Abbot Fulrad pressed the claim of Saint-Denis to Loba’s gift. On 1 March 752 her son Gislemar acknowledged it before Pippin’s court. The judgment styles Pippin king of the Franks.

original.conversionNote: The corresponding proleptic Gregorian date is four days later.
